items.item_text: Current valid California RN license, required
BLS from the American Red Cross or American Heart Association, required
Official Transcripts and/or original diploma from a registered nursing program must be provided upon hire
Please ensure your resume and application clearly specify the unit(s) you have worked on as part of your work experience*
Experience in orthopedic surgery, specifically total joint arthroplasty, preferred
2 years of operating room experience as an RN, required

Take on a rewarding role in a Magnet® designated and world-class health organization.  The Clinical Nurse 2-Operating Room is a professional caregiver who provides direct patient care and assumes responsibility and accountability for surgical patients via the nursing process.

Under direct supervision of the Unit Director and Assistant Unit Director, the incumbent will function in the circulating and scrub role. The clinical nurse is an integral part of the surgical team, working collaboratively to ensure patient safety, implement nursing interventions, and participate in process and quality improvement initiatives.
Skill in implementing appropriate nursing interventions on a consistent basis
Ability to perform historical, physical and behavioral patient assessments
Ability to develop and implement and evaluate patient care plan actively involving patients, family, and staff
